# telnyx_enterprise_reputation (Data Source)

Phone number reputation monitoring for an enterprise: enabled with a signed Letter of Authorization, refreshed at check_frequency. Destroy disables it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enterprise_id` (String) The enterprise id.

### Read-Only

- `check_frequency` (String) How often Telnyx refreshes the stored reputation data for this enterprise's registered numbers. One of `biweekly`, `business_daily`, `daily`, `monthly`, `never`, `weekly`.
- `created_at` (String)
- `external_verification_status` (String) Review state of the enterprise's ownership proof for numbers hosted with another provider. `null` when no proof was submitted.
- `loa_document_id` (String) Id of the signed LOA document.
- `loa_status` (String) Customer-facing Letter-of-Authorization verification state. `approved` is required (alongside reputation status) before phone numbers can be added.
- `rejection_reasons` (List of String) Populated when `status` is `rejected`.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status of the enterprise's Phone Number Reputation activation.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `webhook_url` (String) HTTPS URL that receives number-ownership webhook events for this enterprise.
